visual.general_description: Low-resolution grayscale 12-lead style electrocardiogram print with dense overlying grid hatching.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale ECG print in a four-column, standard-style layout: columns of I/II/III, aVR/aVL/aVF, V1-V3 and V4-V6 over three rows, plus a bottom full-width strip. Printed limb-lead and V-lead labels are small and only partly legible (the aVR, aVL and aVF labels are the clearest). The tracing is overlaid by dense vertical and horizontal hatching that makes baseline and complexes hard to separate. Complexes of differing widths appear at irregular spacing within the rows, and some rows show wide, tall deflections in the right-hand columns. No printed rate, interval values, calibration pulse, patient text or date is visible.

visual.general_description: Telemetry printout with a printed vital-sign header and three stacked two-lead strips.
visual.detailed_description: Page-style telemetry printout. A header block labelled Vitals prints HR 0, PVC 0, SpO2 99, Pulse (SpO2) 98, Perf 3.3, RR 26, NBP 125/78 (89) and Pulse (NBP) 100, each with printed text only. Below are three stacked strips, each with two traces labelled II and V, each trace with a 1 mV calibration bracket, the text ECG Filter: 0.5-35 Hz and a 0.2s scale bar at the lower right. Each strip carries printed timestamps with a calendar date and clock times along its lower edge. Small beat-marker letters N, M and a "?" appear above beats; the third strip has tall vertical bar artifacts and wavy drifting baselines in its right portion. A gray shaded block fills the right end of each strip, and black triangle markers sit between strips.

visual.general_description: Color 12-lead electrocardiogram on pink grid paper with a bottom rhythm strip.
visual.detailed_description: Color ECG on pink gridded paper in four rows. Printed lead labels are I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1, V2, V3, V4, V5 and V6 in a four-column arrangement, and a full-width bottom rhythm strip is labelled V1. A rectangular calibration pulse starts each row. Repeating complexes appear in every row with similar spacing across the strip, and the complex shape differs between leads. No printed rate, interval values, patient text, dates or device text are visible.
